title: Who are you when no one's watching?
subtitle: A few minutes. No right answers.

steps.body:
The self we present to the world requires maintenance. What we exclude from that presentation doesn't disappear — it goes underground, becoming shadow.

This is about noticing the gap.

steps.title: How do the people in your life tend to see you?
steps.body: What role or quality do they expect from you?

steps.title: What's something true about you that most people who know you wouldn't guess?
steps.body: What lives underneath the version they know.

steps.title: How much energy does maintaining the expected version of you take?
What does keeping this gap cost you?
steps.body: In closeness, in aliveness, in creativity.

steps.title: Is there one place where more of the hidden self could come through?

exit.body: The gap between who you perform and who you are is where most of the work lives. You've started naming it.
